'''Pre-Warp Pack''' is the 31st virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on June 23, 2017. The set consists of 18 cards. This set is part of the ''Enterprise Block'' consisting of cards from [[Broken Bow]], [[Pre-Warp Pack]], [[Live Long and Prosper (expansion)|Live Long and Prosper]], [[Cold Front (expansion)|Cold Front]], and [[Enterprise Collection Remastered (expansion)|Enterprise Collection Remastered]] expansion sets.

The card numbering sequence continues from Virtual Preview card 70 P Centurion Kirk.
